description: Resolve a path/name/fuzzy target inside a workspace and return full content for that node plus a compact subtree memory index.

subtree_limit.description: Maximum entries in the subtree memory index. Defaults to 50, capped at 500. Raise it only when the compact index is genuinely truncated.

target.description: Node path, name, or fuzzy target such as '/apps/api' or 'auth'.

name: pathrule_goto

error.description: Present only when ok is false.

code.description: Stable machine-readable failure code, for example insufficient_scope, workspace_id_required, rate_limited, not_found, or upstream_error. Branch on this, not on message text.

detail.description: Optional structured context for the failure, for example { missing_scopes: [...] } on insufficient_scope.

memories.description: Active memories on the node, with full content: id, title, content, source.

node.description: The node the target resolved to.

node_id.description: Tree node UUID for the resolved target.

ok.description: true when the call succeeded. false when it did not, in which case `error` carries the reason and the success fields are absent.

rules.description: Active rules on the node, with full content. Obey these.

skills.description: Active skills on the node, with full content.

subtree_memory_index.description: Compact index of memories below the node: { entries, total, truncated }.

title: Go To Node
